name: Car Mechanic Simulator 2021 importer (proof of concept)
description: Bring a Car Mechanic Simulator 2021 car into a new mod from a folder of its models exported with AssetStudio or AssetRipper: every model at the right size, sorted into parts, with the car's text data kept for reference. Only for cars from a copy of the game you own; the mod must be free and say where it came from.
author: JBeam Forge
